How to Register a .pk Domain in Pakistan (2026): A Beginner's Checklist Before You Pay

By ZedgeHost Team · 21 November 2026 · 6 min read

Short answer: a .pk domain costs Rs 4,999 for 2 years at ZedgeHost, because PKNIC registers .pk names for a minimum of 2 years. Pick your ending, register the name in your own business name, and pay in PKR with Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast or bank transfer. Work through the checklist below before you pay, because one detail, the registrant name, cannot be changed later.

Before you pay: the .pk beginner's checklist

A .pk domain is Pakistan's national domain ending, run by the registry PKNIC. Registering one is quick, but a few details are hard to fix after payment. Run through these seven checks first, and the registration itself takes minutes.

  1. Shortlist two or three names. Your first choice may be taken, so have backups ready before you start.
  2. Search each name. Check availability on the domain search page for .pk and the other endings you might want, so you can register them together.
  3. Pick the ending that matches your audience. A general .pk fits most brands, while .com.pk fits a commercial business. See the table below.
  4. Register in the real owner's name. For a business, that is the business itself, not your web designer or an employee. The registrant name cannot be changed later.
  5. Have the owner details ready. A Pakistani address, a working email that someone reads, and a phone number. PKNIC registers .pk names to owners based in Pakistan.
  6. Budget for two years. PKNIC requires a minimum 2-year term, so the smallest first payment covers two years: Rs 4,999 for a .pk at ZedgeHost.
  7. Plan where the domain will point. You do not need hosting to register, but decide early whether the name will point at a website, so the nameserver step does not catch you out later.

.pk, .com.pk, .net.pk or .org.pk: which ending fits?

All four are part of the .pk family and all register for a minimum of 2 years. The difference is who each ending is meant for. If you are unsure, a plain .pk is the safe default for a Pakistani brand. For the full registration steps, see how to register a .pk domain in Pakistan.

7 mistakes beginners make with a .pk domain

1. Registering the domain in someone else's name

This is the most expensive mistake on this list. The registrant is the legal owner of the domain, and PKNIC does not let you change that name later. If your designer or an employee registers the domain in their name, the domain is legally theirs. Always register in the business's own name, with the business address and an email the business controls.

2. Budgeting for one year

A .com can be bought for one year, but a .pk cannot. PKNIC sells .pk family names in 2-year terms, so the smallest first payment covers two years. At ZedgeHost that is Rs 4,999 for a .pk. If you budget for one year, checkout will surprise you, so plan for the two-year price from the start.

3. Picking the wrong ending

A commercial store reads better on .com.pk, a charity on .org.pk, and a general brand on .pk. The endings cost the same effort to register, but the wrong one sends the wrong signal to visitors. If you also want the matching .com, see how to buy a cheap .com domain in Pakistan before you pay.

4. Buying the domain and forgetting the website

A domain on its own is only an address, not a website. After registration you still need to point it at hosting by setting the nameservers or DNS records, and then build the site. If you have no hosting yet, shared hosting from Rs 1,499 per year includes free SSL, free cPanel, daily backups and free migration, and a WordPress site can be installed in one click from WordPress hosting from Rs 1,499 per year.

5. Using an email nobody reads

Renewal reminders, ownership confirmations and registry notices all go to the registrant email. Use a mailbox that someone in the business actually checks, not a personal inbox that gets abandoned. If that email stops working, you can miss the renewal notice and lose the name.

6. Letting the domain expire

A .pk name runs for two years, which is long enough to forget about. Set a renewal reminder for a month before expiry, and confirm the renewal price at checkout before you pay, so the second term holds no surprise. An expired domain can be taken by someone else, and getting it back is slow and uncertain.

7. Paying the wrong way

You do not need an international card to register a .pk domain. At ZedgeHost you pay in PKR with Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast or bank transfer. See how to pay with JazzCash or Easypaisa for the steps, and check how ordering works before you buy, so you know each step from search to activation.

How much does a .pk domain cost?

At ZedgeHost a .pk domain costs Rs 4,999 for the 2-year term. PKNIC, the registry, lists Rs 2,100 per year for registrants based in Pakistan, billed two years at a time. Other endings in the .pk family are priced on request, so confirm the price at checkout before you pay. For comparison, a .com costs Rs 2,999 for the first year and Rs 3,999 to renew, and web hosting in Pakistan starts at Rs 1,499 per year.

After registration: three things to do

  1. Point the domain at your hosting. Set the nameservers or DNS records to your hosting account, then allow time for the change to spread across the internet.
  2. Set up email on your domain. An address on your own domain looks more professional than a free mailbox, and it is the address customers will trust.
  3. Set a renewal reminder. Two years passes quickly. Put a reminder a month before expiry, so the name never lapses by accident.
